From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Q2 coverage check — request for stage refresh and commit review
Cc: 

Team,

Quick heads-up: finance wants a cleaned-up pipe-to-quota snapshot by EOD Monday so they can finalize the Q2 forecast. Current ask is simple but time-sensitive — we need accurate stage updates, clear commits, and a short note on any gaps that require management attention.

Baseline targets and where we stand (quick reference):
- Q2 quota (net new revenue): $3.2M
- Coverage target for healthy forecast: 3.5x (total weighted pipeline = $11.2M)
- Last automated pull (Mar 10): total weighted pipeline = $7.0M (~2.2x coverage)

What I need from each owner by EOD Monday (Mar 16):
1) Stage refresh in the shared sheet (link below) with updated amounts and % probability by deal.
2) Explicit commit list: deals you will actively fund/close this quarter, with close date and blocker status.
3) Any deals you want me to escalate (clear reason + ask).

Priority items I see today: Acme Health (Ben) — gap versus coverage target is material. Priyom, Vivek — please verify whether any in Late Eval should be promoted to Commit with engineering bandwidth confirmed. Evelyn, finance will need your confirmation on the burn assumptions if we plan to add upside credits.

Attachments: Q2_pipe_snapshot_Mar15.xlsx (sheet with exported pipeline), commit_template_v2.csv (simple commit export to paste into the forecast sheet).

Links: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcDEFgHIjKL_mk-pipeline-summary

I will run a 20-min sync Monday 10:00 PT if needed (quick triage). If you can do an inline reply with your top 3 commits today, that helps avoid the call.

Thanks —
Marissa

> Thanks Marissa — quick status from my side for Acme Health and a couple other north-star deals:

Thanks for the updates — a couple of quick operational requests so finance can ingest cleanly: 

Operational asks (we need consistency):
- Use the commit_template_v2.csv fields exactly: deal_id, company, ARR_delta, weighted_value, stage, rep_owner, close_date, blockers, legal_status. I'll run a script that maps these into forecast buckets.
- Tag any deal that lacks a signed SLA/KMS as "requires_security_evidence" in the blockers column — that will flag for the security/compliance queue.
- Set close_date to end-of-month granularity if the exact day is unknown but still in quarter (helps our month-by-month pacing).

I ran a quick pivot on the March 10 dump and confirmed the 2.2x number Marissa called out. If we take Ben's midline and apply 60% of Late Eval, coverage moves to ~2.9x. Still short.

Proposed tactical moves for Monday:
- Promote two high-probability Late Eval deals to Commit only if engineering windows are confirmed and legal milestones have owners.
- Re-run the weighted forecast after these promotions and present both conservative (as-is) and upside (promotions applied) to Finance.

I'll update the shared sheet (highlighted cells) and push a cleaned export to the Drive by 8pm PT.

Vivek

1) Ben: please escalate Acme's legal KMS ask in the thread to Legal by EOD today. If Legal cannot confirm a signing plan, mark Acme as "At Risk" and add details in blockers.
2) Priyom: mirror Ben's approach on any Late Eval deals >$250k and confirm engineering slot availability in writing.

Evelyn, if you can accept the two-scenario output (conservative + promoted-commits upside), Finance will use conservative for official guidance but will keep the upside in the reserves modelling. If that works, I'll close the loop with CFO.

I ran the numbers with Vivek's cleaned export — conservative = 2.4x, promoted-commits upside = 3.1x. Still shy of the 3.5x target but much improved. Let's aim to reduce the remaining gap by 3/23 executive reviews.

If nobody needs the 10:00 PT sync, we'll skip it and I'll circulate the final sheet. Otherwise I'll keep the slot.
